key.name: show-caps-lock
key.description: Display the Caps Lock indicator in the top panel.

key.name: show-num-lock
key.description: Display the Num Lock indicator in the top panel.

key.name: hide-when-off
key.description: Hide the indicator completely when the lock is turned off instead of dimming it.

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Display OSD notification when toggling touchpad, Caps Lock or Num Lock.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the touchpad panel indicator.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: Shortcut to toggle the touchpad state.
